sloka: समंतात् अभिसंपत्य सिंह व्याघ्र मृग द्विजाः ।अन्वधावन् तदा रोषात् सीताम् छाया अनुगामिनः ॥३-५२-३६॥
transliteration: samaṁtāt abhisaṁpatya siṁha vyāghra mṛga dvijāḥ ।anvadhāvan tadā roṣāt sītām chāyā anugāminaḥ ॥3-52-36॥

translations.english: Then the lions, tigers, deer and birds gathered together in anger (also anguish) and ran after Sita's shadow.
